text:
jess: ACME support case — customer says streaming response cuts off mid-json when their quota triggers. Example SSE payload we captured:

jess: ```
data: {"id":"resp_01","object":"text_generation","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"},"index":0}]}
data: {"id":"resp_01","object":"text_generation","choices":[{"delta":{"content":" and then ends abruptly with no finish_reason..."},"index":0}]}
<socket closed>
```

jess: No trailing 'data: [DONE]' or finish field. Customer sees invalid JSON parse error on their client.

sam: which model / region / client SDK? any req id?

jess: model=redwood-xl-v1, region=us-east-1, req-id=rn_7e8f9, SDK=browser fetch streaming (EventSource polyfill). Token rotation in their app; they said token refresh happened ~3s before close.

maria: can you paste server side headers from proxied response? any 429/502?

jess: headers we have: `HTTP/2 200` then mid-stream `HTTP/2 429 Retry-After: 1` from our rate-limiter service. Logs show upstream closed stream when limiter returned 429. raw tail:

jess: ```
...data chunk
error: upstream returned 429
socket: FIN
```

devon: this is likely our rate-limiter short-circuiting the connection instead of letting runtime emit final sentinel. The runtime doesn't get to run finish handlers when conn is aborted. Possible repro: trigger quota throttle mid-response.

sam: can you repro locally? steps?

jess: repro steps (minimal):
1) start a long-generation stream: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-xl-v1 -d '{"max_tokens":1000,"prompt":"long..."}'`
2) from another session, increment client quota to exceed limit for that key quickly (we used a test throttle rule)
3) observe the stream ends with incomplete last JSON and no finish event

sam: ok. short-term workaround: client should treat socket EOF as terminal and attempt a fresh request with `resume_from` using last token index (we can add resume token in next runtime patch). For now advise clients to tolerate EOF and check partial last event parse.

maria: long-term fix: ensure rate-limiter returns a graceful server-sent event before closing (e.g., `event: error` or `data: {"finish_reason":"rate_limited"}`) and make proxy not terminate mid-body. Filed infra task INF-4482.

jess: I've told customer the temporary guidance and filed bug. tagging @devon for prioritization :flag-us:

devon: ACK. I'll pick up INF-4482, will add a regression test that simulates limiter during streaming and expect final sentinel.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-345 (linked INF-4482), priority P2, assignee: devon

carol: billing note — ACME saw a spike and then throttles kicked in. Please coordinate with Billing to not double-charge partial streams.

jess: noted. I'll loop in billing. Closing loop when INF done.
